plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Yeastar voice gateway. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, disk usage, and interface traffic, for P-Series IP PBX and VoIP gateways (enterprise PEN 22736).
name: VoiceGateway

metrics.name: cpu_usage_percent
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Yeastar P-Series platform (pCPUUtilization under IANA PEN 22736). The device exposes a percent text value which is parsed to a 0-100 numeric gauge. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate call-processing pressure or abnormal control-plane load.

metrics.name: memory_usage_percent
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Yeastar P-Series platform (pMemoryUsage under IANA PEN 22736). The device exposes a percent text value which is parsed to a 0-100 numeric gauge. Sustained high memory usage may indicate resource pressure or unstable services.

metrics.name: local_storage_usage_percent
metrics.description: Local storage utilization of the Yeastar P-Series platform (pLocalStorageUsage under IANA PEN 22736). The device exposes a percent text value which is parsed to a 0-100 numeric gauge. High usage can exhaust recording or system storage.

metrics.name: concurrent_calls
metrics.description: Number of concurrent calls on the Yeastar P-Series platform (pConcurrentCall under IANA PEN 22736). Use this gauge to watch voice capacity against the licensed or hardware call limit.

metrics.name: asterisk_status
metrics.description: Telephony-engine status of the Yeastar P-Series platform (pAsteriskStatus under IANA PEN 22736), normalized so running(1) is 1 = healthy and every other or unknown value is 2 = fault.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
